title: Insane Drunk Woman Goes on a Tire-Slashing Rampage, Bites & Runs Over Mailbox!
description:
On December 12th, 2023, officers in Ohio received a call reporting a female slashing tires in a residential area. Following the initial call, other concerned witnesses called in, reporting a female in a green Dodge Dakota striking a parked vehicle and running over a mailbox. Officers quickly arrived at the location and located the green Dodge with the female sitting in the driver’s seat.

Upon approaching the vehicle, the officers noted the suspect exhibiting clear signs of intoxication. Officers ordered the driver to exit her vehicle, but the suspect refused, leading to officers physically assisting her out and into custody. The suspect continued to display aggressive and non-compliant behavior, including physical resistance and verbal threats towards the officers. The suspect was placed in the back of the patrol car where she refused to place her feet inside to let officers close the door.

While in the back of the patrol vehicle, the suspect removed her handcuffs while kicking and screaming. While attempting to resecure the suspect’s handcuffs, the suspect physically resisted the officers, showing highly combative behavior. After eventually safely detaining the suspect, she was transported to jail. The suspect was charged with Public Intoxication and Resisting Arrest.
